nodes.description: Private mapping(address=>uint256) holding token balances of every account.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance used by approve/transferFrom.
Public whitelist mapping(address=>bool); whitelisted accounts bypass the elephant transfer cap.
Public blacklist/flag mapping(address=>bool) that also forces allowance to 134 in _approve.
Private bootstrap flag; first transfer from creator whitelists the recipient and clears the flag.
Private total token supply, increased by _mint and reduced by _burn.
Private transfer cap / burn threshold; owner-settable via BurnTheFruits and read in _transfer.
Private snapshot of the initial elephant cap, set only in the constructor.
Private token decimals, initialized to 5 in the constructor.
Private token symbol string, initialized to PAPAYA.
Private token name string, initialized to Papaya Finance.
Private one-shot flag used in _approve to auto-whitelist a spender for the creator.
Private deployer address; special-cased in _transfer and _approve.
Public monotonically increasing counter used as weak entropy in randomly().
Private Ownable owner address controlling onlyOwner functions.
Private secondary owner-like address initialized to the deployer and used by SetBurnAddress.
Contract constructor: sets creator/owner, token metadata, initial supply and bootstrap flags.
External ERC20 transfer that delegates to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
Internal pseudo-random generator keccak256(now, msg.sender, saslaisgood) % 100.
Internal transfer with hidden whitelist/blacklist and timestamp-random logic plus elephant cap.
Internal allowance setter that can silently replace the amount with 134 based on kumquat.
External ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
External ERC20 transferFrom performing _transfer then allowance reduction.
Public helper increasing an allowance via SafeMath.add and _approve.
Public helper decreasing an allowance via SafeMath.sub and _approve.
Only-owner mint entry point calling _mint for the caller.
Only-owner setter for the airplane whitelist and kumquat flag mappings.
Only-owner setter that overwrites the elephant transfer cap.
Unguarded function that assigns _owner = picture, allowing a public ownership takeover.
Only-owner ownership transfer delegating to _transferOwnership.
Internal ownership assignment with zero-address check.
Only-owner renunciation that sets _owner to address(0).
Internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances.
Internal burn that reduces _balances and _totalSupply.
Internal burn from an account then allowance reduction via _approve.
Only-owner view returning a copy of the elephant cap.
Modifier requiring _owner == _msgSender(); missing on SetBurnAddress.
Public view returning the current _owner.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership, minting and randomness seeding.
now used as entropy inside randomly(), making outcomes miner-influenceable.
Pseudo-random computation keccak256(abi.encodePacked(now, msg.sender, saslaisgood)) % 100.
SetBurnAddress() lacks onlyOwner, so any account can seize ownership after the first owner change.
_approve forces the stored allowance to the magic value 134 when kumquat[owner] is true.
saslaisgood++ is a raw unchecked increment outside SafeMath.
_transfer mutates _balances without a reentrancy guard while external entry points call it.
recipient address parameter of transfer/transferFrom.
amount uint256 parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve-family functions.
spender address parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
sender address parameter of transferFrom.
owner address parameter of allowance and _approve.
newOwner address parameter of transferOwnership/_transferOwnership.
addedValue uint256 parameter of increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue uint256 parameter of decreaseAllowance.
val bool parameter of CheckTheAddress writing airplane.
val2 bool parameter of CheckTheAddress writing kumquat.
Local tok in _approve holding the possibly overridden allowance value.
Local tempval in ViewSomething copying elephant.
Local screen in randomly holding the pseudo-random result.
Local msgSender in the Ownable constructor caching _msgSender().

edges.reason: transfer() delegates balance movement to internal _transfer().
approve() delegates to internal _approve().
transferFrom() moves tokens through _transfer().
transferFrom() reduces the allowance through _approve().
increaseAllowance() updates allowance through _approve().
decreaseAllowance() updates allowance through _approve().
FruitBowl() mints new tokens via _mint().
_burnFrom() destroys tokens via _burn().
_burnFrom() reduces the caller allowance via _approve().
transferOwnership() delegates to _transferOwnership().
transferOwnership() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
ViewSomething() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
BurnTheFruits() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
CheckTheAddress() is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
SetBurnAddress() reaches an unguarded ownership assignment because onlyOwner is missing.
Any external caller (msg.sender) can invoke the unguarded SetBurnAddress().
_transfer() calls randomly(), pulling block.timestamp into transfer logic.
_transfer() mutates _balances without a reentrancy guard around its external entry points.
_transfer() writes the updated sender and recipient balances into _balances.
_transfer() reads _balances to compute the new sender/recipient amounts.
_transfer() reads the airplane whitelist to gate the elephant cap.
_transfer() reads and writes kumquat flags for sender and recipient.
_transfer() reads the nokia bootstrap flag for the first creator transfer.
_transfer() reads elephant to enforce require(amount < elephant) for non-whitelisted senders.
_transfer() compares the sender against creator for the bootstrap branch.
randomly() output decides kumquat[recipient] inside _transfer(), making transfers timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp (now) is packed into the weak randomness computation.
msg.sender is attacker-controllable entropy in the weak randomness computation.
msg.sender is consumed as entropy by randomly().
saslaisgood counter is packed into the predictable randomness computation.
randomly() realises the unsafe pseudo-random operation using on-chain inputs.
saslaisgood++ is an unguarded integer increment.
The unchecked increment writes the new saslaisgood value back to storage.
CheckTheAddress() whitelists an address by writing airplane[spender].
CheckTheAddress() writes the kumquat flag for an address.
BurnTheFruits() overwrites the elephant transfer cap with an owner-supplied amount.
ViewSomething() returns a copy of the elephant state variable.
_approve() reads the existing _allowances entry for the owner/spender pair.
_approve() writes the new allowance into _allowances[owner][spender].
kumquat[owner] decides whether the allowance is silently forced to 134.
_approve() executes the allowance override that can replace amount with 134.
The keyboard one-shot flag lets the creator auto-whitelist a spender inside _approve().
_approve() compares owner against creator to trigger the privileged branch.
SetBurnAddress() reads picture, the address that becomes the new owner.
SetBurnAddress() checks _owner != picture before reassigning ownership.
SetBurnAddress() assigns _owner = picture, an unguarded ownership takeover.
The constructor sets creator = msg.sender.
The constructor uses msg.sender as the initial creator, balance holder and owner.
The Ownable constructor sets _owner to the deploying account.
The constructor initializes _totalSupply to 4000000000000000.
The constructor derives elephant = _totalSupply / 500 (and opera = elephant).
The constructor credits _balances[msg.sender] with the whole supply.
_mint() reads _totalSupply and increases it with SafeMath.add.
_mint() writes the increased total supply back to storage.
_mint() credits _balances[account] with the minted amount.
_burn() reads _totalSupply and decreases it with SafeMath.sub.
_burn() deducts the burned amount from _balances[account] using SafeMath.sub.
_burn() writes the reduced total supply back to storage.
_burn() writes the reduced balance back into _balances.
The recipient parameter flows into _transfer() as the destination.
The amount parameter flows into _transfer() and the elephant cap check.
The sender parameter flows into _transfer() as the debited account.
The spender parameter flows into _approve() as the allowance target.
The owner parameter flows into _approve() as the allowance holder.
The newOwner parameter flows into _transferOwnership() and becomes _owner.
addedValue flows through SafeMath.add into the _approve() allowance write.
subtractedValue flows through SafeMath.sub into the _approve() allowance write.
The val parameter toggles the airplane whitelist entry.
The val2 parameter toggles the kumquat flag entry.
Local tok carries the overridden allowance value written by _approve().
Local tempval copies elephant and is returned by ViewSomething().
Local screen holds the pseudo-random result returned by randomly().
Local msgSender caches _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.
transfer() uses _msgSender() as the token sender.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender deducting the allowance.
FruitBowl() mints to _msgSender(), relying solely on the onlyOwner guard for authorisation.
msg.sender-derived sender flows into _transfer() through the public entry points.
The weak randomness operation is executed inside randomly().

normalization_plan.reason: recipient parameter only exists to feed the internal _transfer destination.
amount parameter is only used by _transfer and the elephant cap check.
spender parameter is only used as the allowance target in _approve.
sender parameter is only used as the debited account in _transfer.
owner parameter is only used as the allowance holder in _approve.
newOwner parameter is only assigned to _owner inside _transferOwnership.
addedValue is only consumed by the allowance update in _approve.
subtractedValue is only consumed by the allowance update in _approve.
val parameter is only written into the airplane whitelist by CheckTheAddress.
val2 parameter is only written into the kumquat mapping by CheckTheAddress.
local tok is the temporary result of the allowance override inside _approve.
local tempval is only a copy of elephant returned by ViewSomething.
local screen is the temporary pseudo-random result of randomly().
local msgSender only caches _msgSender() in the Ownable constructor.
